worldcombat.skill.brine.summary: Presses a jet of brine at the foe: against a target at half HP or less the hit is doubled, and a hit soaks the target. A single straight jet only — no salt pool and no extra slow, built to finish a target that is already wounded.
worldcombat.skill.brine.use.0: Double down on a target that is already wounded
worldcombat.skill.brine.use.1: Keep the pressure on once a foe drops below half HP
worldcombat.skill.brine.use.2: Fire one long shot just to finish a wounded target
worldcombat.skill.brine.description.0: On a hit, deals about %1$s special damage; while the target is at half HP or less that segment is doubled.
worldcombat.skill.brine.description.1: The jet reaches %1$s blocks, travels at about %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s block hit radius; it splashes only where it lands, on a body or on a block.
worldcombat.skill.brine.description.2: A target hit directly keeps the drenched identity for about %1$s; brine leaves only that mark and adds no extra slow.
worldcombat.skill.brine.press.on: High-pressure mode: power x1.15, range x1.15 and a finer hit radius, but a shorter soak, +2 ticks windup and +4 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.brine.press.off: Spray mode: a wider hit radius, longer soak and cheaper windup and cooldown, but power x0.92.
worldcombat.skill.brine.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s windup it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.brine.growth.0: From level %1$s the jet power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.brine.growth.1: From level %1$s power rises to %2$s and the hit radius grows wider.
worldcombat.skill.brine.preference.press: On (high pressure): power x1.15, range x1.15 and a finer hit radius, but a shorter soak, +2 ticks windup and +4 ticks cooldown, good for finishing the wounded. Off (spray, default): a wider hit radius, longer soak and cheaper windup and cooldown, good for a steadier finish.
worldcombat.skill.brine.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; larger values shoot earlier from farther away.
worldcombat.skill.brine.preference.ai.fi: On: raise this move's priority against targets at half HP or less right now, where it is doubled; a full-health target (including a boss) gets no such credit; off: rank it as an ordinary ranged attack.
worldcombat.skill.brine.description.wet: Soaked is only a shared mark other moves can read; brine no longer slows the target.
